title: debark verify report v1
description: debark.verifyreport/v1 - the machine-readable answer to "can this artifact be trusted", emitted by `debark verify --json`. Never written into a bundle; a wire/API response object. Verification stops at the first hard structural failure, so problems is usually one entry; file-digest checking continues to the end so an operator sees the full extent of a tampered medium.

checked_at.description: When this check ran, RFC 3339 UTC, second precision.

bundle_path.description: Path to the bundle that was checked.

bundle_id.description: The manifest's bundle_id, when the manifest could be parsed.

ok.description: True only when every check passed. A bundle that passes with allow-unsigned has ok true and signed false; a caller must say so explicitly.

signed.description: Whether the bundle carried at least one signature block.

signatures.description: Outcome of checking each signature block present.

files_checked.description: Number of files whose digest was verified.

bytes_checked.description: Total bytes read while verifying file digests.

problems.description: Every failure found. Non-empty here means ok is false.

warnings.description: Non-fatal observations: an unsigned bundle accepted, an unknown extra file, redistribution flags.

target.description: Target identity restated from the manifest, so a caller need not parse the manifest again.

signer_kind.description: Which Signer implementation produced this block.

key_id.description: Identifies the key this block claims to be signed by.

valid.description: True when the signature verified cryptographically against a trusted key.

trusted.description: False when the signature is cryptographically fine but the key is not one the operator supplied out of band.

detail.description: Extra explanation, when there is one.

path.description: The file this problem is about, when it is about one file.

expected.description: Expected digest or size, rendered as a string.

got.description: Actual digest or size found, rendered as a string.
